name: Bedding
description: Bedding planes: horizontal courses of unequal depth, the way sediment actually lies.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 11%, #000 11% 26%, transparent 26% 30%, #000 30% 38%, transparent 38% 44%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 11%, #000 11% 26%, transparent 26% 30%, #000 30% 38%, transparent 38% 44%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
